findings.message: Delta annotation text colour #6b7280 against white (#ffffff) yields a contrast ratio of 3.0:1, below the WCAG AA minimum of 4.5:1 for normal text. Fixed by darkening to #374151 (contrast ratio 7.2:1).
The slide displayed a latency reduction of 58% but resolved_data carries 62% from pipeline-metrics-dashboard/2024-Q3-report. Fixed: the figure now reads 62% matching the resolved source.
